title: Rabbi Nachshon
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Yalkut, Psalms, section 752, saying: in every trouble that reaches us, we find the fulfillment of Scripture's words, “I am with him in trouble.” The statement appears at the end of Midrash Tehillim chapter 46, but without the speaker's name.

notes.text: תשנ״ב is 752; ספ״מו means the end of chapter 46. The absence of the speaker’s name in the parallel is Hyman’s observation.
The consulted Yalkut names Nachshon. The corresponding statement in the consulted Midrash Tehillim passage has no named speaker.
